Torex Graphics — Own Practice
30+ clients across food, fashion, logistics and technology; 180+ assets delivered including logos, packaging and identity systems.

Torex Graphics is a one-person design practice, run out of Akure, built on repeat clients rather than one-off gigs.

I work mostly in CorelDRAW and Photoshop, translating a client's brief — sometimes just a voice note and a product photo — into a flier or campaign that looks like it belongs to a real brand, not a template. Most of my clients come back for the next post, the next event, the next launch.

Outside client work, I'm studying Microbiology at the Federal University of Technology, Akure, where I also serve as Vice Chairman of Adeboye Hall of Residence and design for my church's media team.
